added.summary: The default icon set gains `eye` and `eyeOff`.

fixed.summary: `uppercase`, `lowercase` and `capitalize` transform the drawn text; colours written as `currentColor` (fill, border, outline, shadow, stroke) follow the inherited text colour; the reduced-motion setting reaches class resolution.

Hit testing respects overlapping and clipped nodes, touch and gamepad focus move as on desktop, scroll and pointer capture release cleanly, and multiline Input edits (line moves, selection, paste) behave like a text area.

A whole-world restore brings back a text field's vertical scroll and starts clean: in-flight motion, rolling counts, text selection, undo history, held sticks and queued sounds and haptics are cleared.
